lines: Seat 1 chooses Weaver: at the end, 1 point per 3 tiles in your largest connected group, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Wanderer: at the end, 1 point per separate group of tiles beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 2) for 1 mana.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (-2, 1) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (1, -1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 1) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (-1, 1) (yields 1) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (1, -1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (0, -1) (yields 0) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (0, 2) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 0) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Weaver.
Seat 2's trait is Wanderer.
Seat 3's trait is Warbrand.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 4 mana.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Attune the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for 4 mana, leaving 7. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Summon 11 Imps at (-1, 1) for 11 mana, leaving 0.
Round 1.
Seat 2 and Seat 3 both attune the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2): nobody gets it.
Seat 1 summons 11 Imps at (-1, 1).
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.

An Unveil reveals the Steady tile at (2, -2) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (2, 0) (yields 3, guarded by power 3); the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 1, guarded by power 3); the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 1).
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 4 mana.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.

Attack the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) (Seat 2's, held by no units, power 0) with 11 Imps (power 11). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 11 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Summon 4 Golems at (-1, 0) for 8 mana, leaving 7.
Round 2.
Seat 2 summons 4 Golems at (-1, 0).
Seat 3 summons 3 Golems at (0, -2).
Seat 1 (11 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2), Seat 2's, held by 4 Golems: power 11 against 12.
The attack fails: the attackers are wiped out. The defenders keep 1 Golem.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 2 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 2 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 2 in all.
Round 3 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 pays 1 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 pays 3 mana upkeep.
Attune the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for 4 mana, leaving 4. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Attune the Steady tile at (2, -2) (yields 2) for 4 mana, leaving 6. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Round 3.
Seat 1 attunes the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 2 attunes the Steady tile at (2, -2) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 3 casts Ward on (0, -1): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 3 (3 Golems) attack the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 0), Seat 2's, held by no units: power 9 against 0.
Seat 3 takes (-1, -1) with 3 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 4 in all.
Seat 2 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 4 in all.
Seat 3 banks 3 points (1 for land, 1 for mana, 1 for conquest), 5 in all.
Round 4 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 3); the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 2); the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2).
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 pays 1 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 pays 3 mana upkeep.
Summon 10 Imps at (-2, 0) for 10 mana, leaving 0.
Summon 3 Golems at (-1, 0) for 6 mana, leaving 5.
Round 4.
Seat 1 summons 10 Imps at (-2, 0).
Seat 2 summons 3 Golems at (-1, 0).
Seat 3 casts Ward on (0, -1): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 3 (3 Golems) attack the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2), Seat 1's, held by 10 Imps: power 9 against 10.
The attack fails: the attackers are wiped out. The defenders keep 1 Imp.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 5 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 5 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 6 in all.
Round 5 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 pays 4 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.

Attack the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 0) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 1 Imp (power 1). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Imp. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.

Attack the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 0) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Golems (power 9). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Golems. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Round 5.
Seat 3 attunes the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2) for 5 mana.
Seat 3 casts Ward on (-1, -1): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 1 (1 Imp) and Seat 2 (3 Golems) attack the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 0), Seat 3's, held by no units: power 10 against 3.
Seat 2 takes (-1, -1) with 3 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 3 points (2 for land, 1 for mana), 8 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (1 for land, 1 for mana, 1 for conquest), 8 in all.
Seat 3 banks 3 points (2 for land, 1 for mana), 9 in all.
Round 6 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 pays 4 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 7 mana.
Summon 12 Imps at (-1, 1) for 12 mana, leaving 0.

Attack the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 2) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Golems (power 9). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Golems. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Round 6.
Seat 1 summons 12 Imps at (-1, 1).
Seat 3 summons 5 Imps at (0, -2).
Seat 2 (3 Golems) attack the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 2), Seat 3's, held by 5 Imps: power 9 against 5.
Seat 2 takes (0, -2) with 2 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 9 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (2 for land, 0 for mana, 1 for conquest), 11 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 10 in all.
Round 7 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 pays 3 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Move 1 Golem from (0, -2) to (-1, -1).
Summon 4 Golems at (-1, 0) for 8 mana, leaving 6.
Cast Lure for 3 mana: the guards at (-1, 2) drop to power 2, for good.

Attack the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 9 Imps (power 9). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 9 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 3.
Round 7.
Seat 2 moves 1 group of units.
Seat 3 attunes the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 2 summons 4 Golems at (-1, 0).
Seat 1 casts Lure on (-1, 2): its guards drop to power 2.
Seat 3 casts Ward on (0, -1): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 1 (9 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (0, 1) (yields 2), Seat 3's, held by no units: power 9 against 0.
Seat 1 takes (0, 1) with 9 Imps.
Seat 1 banks 4 points (2 for land, 1 for mana, 1 for conquest), 13 in all.
Seat 2 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 13 in all.
Seat 3 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 12 in all.
Round 8 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 pays 7 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Cast Leyline for 3 mana: move 3 Golems from (-1, 0) to (1, -1).

Attack the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 1, guarded by power 3) (guarded by monsters, power 3) with 3 Golems (power 9). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 2 Golems. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 4.
Cast Ward for 3 mana: (-2, 0) defends with 3 more power this round.

Attack the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 2) (guarded by monsters, power 2) with 3 Imps (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Imp. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 8.
Round 8.
Seat 3 summons 2 Golems at (0, -1).
Seat 1 casts Ward on (-2, 0): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 2 casts Leyline: 3 Golems travel from (-1, 0) to (1, -1).
Seat 1 (3 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 2), guarded by monsters: power 3 against 2.
Seat 1 takes (-1, 2) with 1 Imp.
Seat 2 (3 Golems) attack the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 1, guarded by power 3), guarded by monsters: power 9 against 3.
Seat 2 takes (1, 0) with 2 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 3 points (2 for land, 0 for mana, 1 for conquest), 16 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (2 for land, 0 for mana, 1 for conquest), 16 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 13 in all.
Seat 1's trait, Weaver: a group of 6 tiles, 2 points, 18 in all.
Seat 2's trait, Wanderer: 2 separate groups, 1 point, 17 in all.
Seat 3's trait, Warbrand: 1 rival tile taken, 1 point, 14 in all.
The match is over. Seat 1 wins.
